input.question: For moving your character forward, do you want to steer with the physical joystick, or use a mouth-breath pattern?

options.label: Triple puff, held pattern — how you move forward in 47% of your games, e.g. 007 - First Light
Physical joystick tilted forward — how you move forward in 35% of your games, e.g. Flight Simulator
Left-center puff — used for this in GTA V FiveM

input.why: Their strongest single pattern for this control (mp_right_center_sip, tap 200) appears in 41% of their games, e.g. Battlefield 2042 QMP4 row 45; a momentary tap fits Elden Ring's lock-on toggle.
mp_right_sip is their chosen input for this control in 36% of their games combined (Apex x360 row 38, Construction-Simulator row 170); using it plain fits a simple repeatable attack press.

Tied at 27% with the physical joystick tilt in their history, but the joystick's forward/back axis is being reserved for character movement in this profile, leaving mp_center_puff (007 - First Light row 32) as the workable evidenced option.
Their dominant pattern for this control, used in 38% of their games, e.g. Apex x360 row 39; the short delay avoids a brief lip touch triggering guard while still holding it to block.
Their dominant pattern for this control, used in 46% of their games, e.g. ARC Raiders x360 row 32, toggling the skill on and off.
Clear majority pattern for this control, used in 38% of their games, e.g. ARC Raiders x360 row 30.
mp_right_sip_soft is their chosen input for this control in 56% of their games combined, and delay_off 250 is the single leading function at 38%, e.g. ARC Raiders x360 row 34.
Clear majority pattern for this control, used in 40% of their games, e.g. 007 - First Light row 43.

mp_left_puff is their combined leading choice for this control at 20% across two delay variants, e.g. CoD Black Ops 6 row 44 and CoD Modern Warfare II row 42; using the more common of the two delay values.
